_comment: Shared work queue for the solaris-android autoloop. Single source of truth between Planner/Builder/Verify. Copy to .claude/state/work-queue.json if absent. Labels are mirrored FROM this file, never the reverse.

_schemas.queue_unit: {id, kind:'cluster'|'issue', issues:[int], theme, region, scope, acceptance, gate:'normal'|'verify', security:false, status:'planned'|'in_progress'|'built'|'blocked', pr:null, notes}
_schemas.review: {issue, pr, flag, since}  (security:true draft PRs — never auto-merge)
_schemas.device_test: {issue, pr, apk, what_to_check, since}  (human sideloads + confirms)
_schemas.upstream_waits: {issue, cross_repo_issue, reason, since}  (blocked on solarisbay/servicebay ticket)
